description:
The campaign receipt's provenance.runtime.invocation field records only the executable name, omitting the arguments of the invocation that produced each run, so a multi-invocation resumable campaign cannot be reproduced invocation-for-invocation from the receipt.

## Background

Receipts record invocation as a one-element vector such as ["ebch_osd_awgn_campaign"]. Resumable campaigns are sequences of bounded invocations whose per-invocation sample bounds shape the recorded attempt history; without the argument vector the receipt's attempt history cannot be regenerated exactly. The checkpoint and receipt record per-attempt sample counts, which bound but do not determine the arguments used.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The receipt records the complete argument vector of every invocation that contributed an attempt, alongside that attempt's provenance.
- [hard] REQ-02: A resumed campaign's receipt preserves each contributing invocation's arguments rather than only the latest.
- [hard] REQ-03: Existing committed receipts remain readable, with the single-element form documented as the prior format.
title: campaign receipt records binary name only, not the invocation arguments
